claims.speaker: Bobby Long
claims.sentence: Total operating expenses were approximately $31.4 million, resulting in operating income of $8.9 million, including a $4.7 million net gain on the sale of oil and gas properties.

claims.speaker: Bobby Long
claims.sentence: Below the operating line, the most significant item was $16.6 million of net loss on derivative contracts.

claims.speaker: Bobby Long
claims.sentence: GAAP net loss was $9.2 million, or $0.70 per share, compared to a net loss of $0.3 million in the third quarter of 2025, as higher operating income, including the net gain on property sales, was offset by derivative losses and higher interest expense.
